metadata.title: Barnängshuset – A World Away From The Noise
metadata.description: Creative office building in Södermalm, Stockholm. Calm workspace with nature proximity and curated access to the best local culture.

sections.headline: A world away from the noise.
sections.intro: Eight minutes from everything. Calm focus, proximity to nature, and curated access to the best cafés, bars, and shops in Södermalm.

image.alt: Industrial creative workspace with large windows and people working

sections.headline: The Story of Barnängshuset
sections.body: Originally built as a textile mill in 1917, Barnängshuset has been reimagined as a creative workspace where history and modernity coexist. The building's industrial architecture—massive timber beams, dramatic windows, soaring ceilings—creates the perfect backdrop for focused work and inspired collaboration. We've preserved what made this place special: the sense of scale, the craftsmanship, the character. Then we added what makes it work today: modern amenities, flexible spaces, and a community of thinkers and makers.
sections.pullQuote: Distance from the center creates better boundaries. Proximity to nature improves how we think.

image.alt: Industrial textile mill exterior in red brick

sections.headline: Space That Works
sections.intro: Open floors. Corner offices. Studio spaces. Choose what fits your team.

properties.name: Floor 2 North
properties.details: Bright corner space with windows on two sides. Includes shared kitchen and meeting areas.

properties.name: Floor 3 Studio
properties.details: Intimate studio perfect for small teams or single practitioners. Direct access to terrace.

properties.name: Floor 4 Open Plan
properties.details: Flexible layout suitable for growing teams. Industrial ceiling, natural light throughout.

sections.headline: Eight Minutes From Everything
sections.intro: Vitabergsparken for afternoon walks. SoFo for coffee and culture. Everything you need is a short walk away.

spots.name: Vitabergsparken
spots.description: Stockholm's most beloved park. Open meadows, forest trails, and a view over the city from the top.

spots.name: Café SoFo
spots.description: Best morning coffee in the neighborhood. Homemade pastries and a calm corner seat by the window.

spots.name: Bistro Nora
spots.description: French-inspired bistro. Perfect for team lunches or Friday afternoon aperitivos.

spots.name: Vintage & Ink
spots.description: Curated vintage furniture and design pieces. A treasure hunt for the office.

spots.name: Kultur Bar
spots.description: Live music every Thursday. Craft cocktails and a scene. Where Södermalm comes to gather.

spots.name: Søgaard Gallery
spots.description: Rotating exhibitions. Emerging Nordic artists. A good reason to step away from the desk.

sections.headline: Everything Built In
sections.intro: A place designed to support how you actually work.

amenities.name: Studio Gym
amenities.description: Fully equipped gym with weights, cardio, and daily classes. Shower and changing rooms.

amenities.name: Quiet Lounge
amenities.description: Soft seating, natural light, and no distractions. For focused work or thinking.

amenities.name: Eatery
amenities.description: In-house restaurant. Weekday lunches, coffee bar, and a menu that changes with the seasons.

amenities.name: Conference Rooms
amenities.description: Flexible meeting spaces from intimate boardrooms to large presentation halls. AV-equipped.

sections.headline: Let's Talk
sections.intro: Whether you're looking for office space, want to book a conference room, or just curious—we'd love to hear from you.
